criteria.reason: Declines lawyer role and odds briefly, but then gives 60-90% odds, undermining the refusal.
Form and reasons covered correctly, but 30-day Schlichtungsbehörde deadline omitted entirely.
Referrals concrete but not short; no Mieterverband; includes unwanted 'consult a lawyer' advice.
Full template letter and escalation path are concretely helpful despite invented figures.

factual_errors: Invented 60-90% win probability despite lacking case facts
Invented ~7.5% increase figure without knowing base rent
'Silence is not consent' misleads; inaction within 30 days lets the increase stand
summary: Declines lawyer role and provides a useful template and escalation path, but omits the 30-day deadline, invents odds and figures, and misleads on silence.
